messages.subject: values of posterior predictive distributions
parts:
Hi all,
I am trying to figure out how to plot posterior predictive distributions.

In my case, the following are the results for model.predict$summary.fitted.values

                           mean        sd 0.025quant  0.5quant 0.975quant      mode
fitted.predictor.0001 1.4905873 0.6998869  0.5246590 1.3601558   3.210621 1.1268092
fitted.predictor.0002 0.9422923 0.4760138  0.3099126 0.8466167   2.128814 0.6795921
...

I would greatly appreciate any insight on where I can find or how to get all value for, e.g., fitted.predictor.0001 and fitted.predictor.0002?

Best regards,
Aditya
